Five AI agent tools launched this week — and one of them edits video inside ChatGPT.

✅ TwelveLabs Jockey: finds moments in your footage and cuts a rough edit (free tier available)
✅ Profound agents: watch how AI search talks about your brand — and act before you approve
✅ Warmy Adeline: the first AI agent that investigates why your emails hit spam
✅ Aligned Seller Agent: an AI that lives inside your deals, not beside them
✅ MediaClaw: an entire PR agency rebuilt as agents, from the Marketwire founders

Five agent tools went live between October 12 and 18, 2026, and every one of them takes real action inside a workflow. This course breaks down what each one does, what it costs, and who it is built for — plus four more launches on the radar. The pattern underneath all of them: the agent that knows your work beats the agent you have to brief.
